definitions.gloss: constantly, all the time, frequently, always
definitions.explanation: Describes something that happens very often, to the point of being excessive or notable. Colloquial and slightly exaggerated.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧しょっちゅう⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、しょっちゅう⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}く→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Lately, I've been getting headaches all the time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、しょっちゅう⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べていた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: When I was a student, I was always eating ramen at that shop.

notes:
A casual adverb meaning "all the time" or "constantly." Derived from ⟦{始終|しじゅう}→始終：04192_shijuu⟧ (from beginning to end).

FREQUENCY SCALE (high → low):
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always (neutral)
- しょっちゅう: constantly, all the time (casual, emphatic)
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: often (neutral)
- ⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧: sometimes
- ⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧: occasionally

USAGE:
More casual and emphatic than ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ or ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧. Often carries a feeling of "too often" or slight exasperation. Common in spoken Japanese but avoided in formal writing.

EXAMPLE PATTERNS:
- しょっちゅう⟦{遅刻|ちこく}する→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧: to be late all the time
- しょっちゅう⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fight constantly
- しょっちゅう⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go there all the time

REGISTER:
Informal/colloquial. In formal contexts, use ⟦{頻繁|ひんぱん}→頻繁：08631_hinpan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (frequently) or ⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (constantly) instead.
